narrative.overview: The guide behaves like a cabinetmaker's cutting sheet enlarged for use beside a saw: exact bars, visible waste, hard cut ticks, oversized part marks, and short instructions placed where the work occurs. It is dense but never decorative.
dos: Do show dimensions and code marks directly on the relevant geometry.
Do distinguish kept offcuts, terminal waste, and gang-cut waste.
Do preserve a clear black-and-white print fallback.
donts: Don't hide manufacturing detail inside hover-only interactions.
Don't use dashboard cards, decorative charts, or unlabeled icons.
Don't scale diagrams independently when relative stock usage matters.
